findings.check: a large overnight move is explained by a corporate action
findings.detail: moves of at least 40.0% between CONSECUTIVE trading days no more than 10 days apart; a corporate action on the same ISIN within 3 days counts as explained. 566 explained, 1597 not. A further 70 large moves were excluded as resumptions after a long silence -- those are not overnight moves and are reported separately rather than counted as defects.

gap_note: Gaps are listed, not failed. NSE holidays are not derivable from this table, so a holiday and a hole look identical here and a human has to tell them apart.
